ios.desc:
Whether you're 8 or 80, a complete beginner or seasoned artist, StampFX makes pixel art animation approachable and fun for everyone. Create stunning animated stickers, GIFs, and pixel art with an intuitive frame-by-frame animation tool designed for all skill levels.

No artistic experience required. Just tap, draw, and watch your creations come to life. Perfect for animated stickers, reaction GIFs, retro-style animations, and creative projects on your iPhone or iPad.

POWERFUL ANIMATION TOOLS

Bring your pixel art to life with intuitive creative features:

• Frame-by-frame animation with instant preview
• 12 specialized drawing tools (pixel, line, circle, rectangle, flood fill, and more)
• Customizable brush sizes and shapes for pencil, eraser, ellipse, rectangle, and line tools
• Quick frame cloning, duplication, and rearrangement
• Pervasive undo for fearless creativity
• Mini Sprites: stamp hand-picked 1-bit mini sprites right onto your canvas
• Import Image: bring any photo or image onto your canvas to pixelate and remix
• Rotation and flipping tools
• Two-finger pinch and zoom for precise control
• Eyedropper for perfect color matching

CREATE FUN ANIMATIONS

StampFX is perfect for making:

• Animated stickers for iMessage
• Reaction GIFs to share with friends
• Pixel art characters and animations
• Retro-style animated art
• Creative projects and personal artwork

BEAUTIFUL COLOR PALETTES

Create your own, generate a palette from any image, or choose from carefully curated palettes inspired by:

• Classic video game consoles
• Retro operating systems
• Nature themes (fire, ocean, forest)
• Monochrome options (17 shades of gray, sepia)
• Web-safe colors
• Custom hue ranges

FLEXIBLE CANVAS SIZES

Create at your ideal resolution with canvases up to 512x512:

• Tiny (perfect for 16x16 icons)
• Small (great for 32x32 sprites)
• Medium (ideal for detailed work)
• Large (for high-resolution assets)
• Custom sizes up to 512x512 pixels

ANIMATION SPEED CONTROL

Fine-tune your animation timing:

• Slow (study details)
• Medium (natural motion)
• Fast (rapid action)

EXPORT & SHARE ANYWHERE

Your creations work everywhere:

• Animated GIF export
• iMessage sticker integration
• AirDrop to Mac or other devices
• Email sharing
• Save to Files app
• Compatible with any app that supports GIFs

PRIVACY FIRST

We respect your creativity:

• Zero personal data collection
• No analytics or tracking
• Your art stays yours
• Work offline anytime

quotes.text:
I recently created an app to help make and animate stamps on iOS with a fun/quirky interface. You can export the stamps as gifs or use the iMessage “stickers” interface to drag them on a text message. It was a passion project. I even created all the assets in the app myself while the app was being developed which was a bit of a stretch creatively for me, but was a ton of fun.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/stampfx/id1583460487#?platform=iphone
